baseline_models.focus_anchor: The genitive construction ءَالَاءِ رَبِّكُمَا and the form-II verb تُكَذِّبَانِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The questioned plural consists of received favors, but رَبّ adds ownership and stepwise repair, nurture, and completion. Form-II denial then becomes an active reclassification of experienced care as false, not simple ignorance of it.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supplies the questioned plurality as benefits already given.
Lordship, ownership, and authority make the favors relationally attributable to their possessor.
Repair, nurture, and completion recast a favor as care that brings a recipient stage by stage to completion.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false makes the dual addressees active judges of the care they receive.

changed_reading.before: Which generic blessings do you two deny?
changed_reading.after: Which experienced acts of your owning, completing Lord do you two actively classify as false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch range of ءَالَاءِ, رَبِّكُمَا, and تُكَذِّبَانِ permits a juridical mechanism inside the same construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: An oath-bearing ءَالَاء is bound to the Lord's pact, while كذب tests whether a charge is made true by being carried through. The question can therefore coexist as a performance test: repudiation occurs in failed enactment as well as speech.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies a pledged or sworn dimension latent in the questioned noun.
Covenant or protection pact turns lordship into a binding relation rather than a bare title.
A charge proving true only when carried through supplies the behavioral test for covenant denial.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a false statement about blessings.
changed_reading.after: Which Lord-bound pledges do you two make false by failing to carry their charge through?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's split mapping for focus ء ل و includes the non-dominant ت ل و inventory, alongside رَبّ and verbal denial.
baseline_models.mechanism: A remainder or liability that follows its holder turns each questioned item into an outstanding right of the Lord that accompanies the two addressees. This does not replace the favor reading; it exposes an accounting shadow within it.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what preceded supplies the image of an unsettled item carried forward.
A liability or right following its holder makes the item a claim that remains attached to the recipients.
Ownership and authority identify whose outstanding right is at issue.
Declaring a claim false supplies the act of repudiation.

changed_reading.before: The plural names gifts that can be remembered or forgotten.
changed_reading.after: The plural can also behave like outstanding rights of the Lord that continue to follow both recipients and demand acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence moves from mercy through disclosure and measured creation to just balance and germinating seed. These are not merely adjacent benefits; together they activate رَبّ as a calibrated nurture system and ءَالَاء as its operations.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors anchors the changed reading in the focus noun.
Stagewise repair and nurture provides the focus mechanism that the ordered context fills out.
Mercy and tenderness supply the governing disposition of the sequence.
Disclosure to a knower makes teaching an enabling favor rather than transferred information alone.
Measuring and proportioning a thing makes creation itself calibrated.
The balance of justice turns cosmic calibration into a normative order for the recipients.
The seed that sprouts and bears grain shows calibrated order becoming nourishment.

structural_cues: 55:1-12 orders mercy, teaching, creation, calculation, balance, earth, and food before the first identical refrain at 55:13.
The sequence crosses cognitive, cosmic, social, and ecological domains without changing the giver named by رَبّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, disclosure, measuring, justice, and germination in sequence; I infer a causal nurture chain from their ordering. A live alternative is that they remain parallel examples rather than stages of one system.

changed_reading.before: The favors are detachable benefits to enumerate.
changed_reading.after: The favors are the Lord's operating system of nurture: disclosing, proportioning, balancing, and bringing life to yield, so denial rejects a sustaining order rather than isolated gifts.

context_deltas.mechanism: At this exact occurrence, the question stands between created discontinuance, the Lord's remaining face, and the daily answering of need. The milk-yield branch of كذب sharpens a category error: a created benefit may cease without the giver or the pattern of care proving false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors anchor the question in what recipients experience across time.
A milk yield that disappears or fails expected duration supplies the mistaken equation between cessation and falsity.
Cutting off and passing away after persistence gives created favors a real temporal limit.
Duration and remaining establish the opposing pole of continuity immediately before the focus.
Staying, clinging, and lasting make the Lord-title itself carry persistence into the focus.
Request and seeking show dependence continuing immediately after the focus.
An affair, condition, or undertaking supplies the field of renewed daily action.

structural_cues: 55:28 is the hinge between 55:26-27 and 55:29, not merely another evenly spaced refrain.
The branchless ج ل ل occurrence at 55:27 intensifies the enduring face structurally but supplies no invented branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, remaining, requests, and daily affair around the focus; I infer that renewed care answers the anxiety produced by transient yields. The alternative is a sharp contrast between mortality and majesty with no renewal arrow.

changed_reading.before: A favor proves genuine only if the particular benefit lasts.
changed_reading.after: Which favors do you call false because their created yield ceases, when cessation belongs to creation while the Lord's answering care remains active?

context_deltas.mechanism: Calculation, just weighing, prohibition of short measure, repeated trailing refrains, and eventual debt-like recompense turn the exploratory remainder/right model into a ledger mechanism. Each recurrence posts what the preceding scene leaves due from both addressees.

activation_trace.role: A right or liability following its holder anchors the focus plural as claims that stay attached.
Declaring a thing false supplies repudiation of the posted claim.
Counting and reckoning establish an accounting register before the refrains begin.
A balance of justice supplies the standard by which each outstanding item is assessed.
Justice and equity make acknowledgment a due proportion rather than arbitrary praise.
Giving short measure supplies the concrete failure mirrored by under-acknowledging received favors.
A remainder following what came before lets the first recurrence function as a carried-forward balance.
Collecting and satisfying a debt confirms the later reciprocal settlement of what is due.

structural_cues: The identical dual question recurs after discrete scenes, so each scene can function as a newly posted line item.
The surah begins with calculation and balance and later states a reciprocal return at 55:60.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accounting branches, a repeated remainder image, and debt settlement; I assign the arrow from each scene to a carried-forward claim. The recurrence could instead be liturgical emphasis without ledger structure.

changed_reading.before: The refrain repeatedly asks for a general admission of gratitude.
changed_reading.after: Each refrain posts an outstanding right generated by the preceding scene: which entries in your Lord's measured account do you two repudiate?

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant responding-voice branch becomes audible only when the focus is placed among identical recurrences and paired structures. Each scene speaks first; the refrain is a second voice cueing the two recipients to answer rather than remain a silent grammatical dual.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another voice anchors the focus as a possible antiphonal response.
The dual act of declaring false defines the answer whose possibility the second voice tests.
The first identical recurrence realizes the responding-voice image outside the focus occurrence.
A connection standing between endpoints provides a relational channel across a pair without erasing distinction.
One counterpart joined to another reinforces the paired-response architecture.

structural_cues: The same dual-ended question recurs thirty-one times while the surah repeatedly presents paired horizons, seas, gardens, springs, and fruits.
The focus verb addresses two together, but the repeated cue leaves open whether they answer together or expose different denials.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a responding-voice branch, exact recurrence, and paired structures; I infer a call-and-response function. A live alternative is a single narrator's repeated interrogation with no assigned respondent voice.

changed_reading.before: The line is a repeated rhetorical question addressed to two beings.
changed_reading.after: The line is an antiphonal summons: each displayed act voices the first part, and the recurring question cues the paired recipients' answering voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The refrain remains operative around limits, failed escape, compelling authority, visible recognition, and the denied destination itself. Favor therefore expands beyond pleasant provision to the truthful boundary and exposure that preserve measure; denial becomes a charge that fails in action.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors keep the warning model anchored in the focus category it expands.
A charge proving true or false through completion turns denial into observable performance.
Crossing a limit in disobedience identifies the disorder that corrective boundaries restrain.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the attempted escape whose failure makes the limit material.
A compelling proof makes authorized passage evidential as well as forceful.
Recognition after a mark or trace makes inward denial externally legible.
Offense and culpability identify denial's acquired consequence.
Explicitly declaring the destination false gives the focus accusation a concrete later object.

structural_cues: Refrains at 55:34, 36, 38, 40, 42, and 45 frame warning and judgment scenes, not only pleasurable provisions.
55:43 names a denied reality immediately before another refrain, converting verbal denial into exposed consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limits, blocked passage, compelling proof, marks, and culpability; I infer that truthful restraint can itself belong to divine favor. The live alternative is that the refrain contrasts favors with punishment rather than including correction within favor.

changed_reading.before: Only welcome gifts can count as the Lord's favors, and denial is mainly verbal.
changed_reading.after: Which truth-preserving limits and exposures do you two reject, when your attempted passage and visible marks make the denial fail in action?

context_deltas.mechanism: The sea, flow, spring, gush, and green-growth sequence activates otherwise dormant material branches of رَبّ: abundant collected water and nurture. The title becomes legible as coordinated hydrological cultivation, not an abstract label detached from the favors.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion provide the causal function joining water to growth.
Abundant collected water gives the Lord-root a material reservoir image.
Broad abundant water supplies the large-scale source domain of the cultivation cycle.
Flowing and coursing move stored abundance into a usable garden process.
A source of running water localizes provision as a spring rather than undifferentiated abundance.
Water welling up abundantly adds pressure and renewal to the supply.
Tender green vegetation is the visible yield of coordinated water and nurture.

structural_cues: The surah moves from paired seas and ships to running and gushing springs, fruits, and intense greenness, with the refrain repeatedly threading the stages.
The water images occur in distinct settings, so their coherence is functional rather than a single continuous scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abundant water, flow, springs, gushing, greenness, and nurture branches; I infer a supply-to-growth arrow joining them. They may alternatively remain independent maritime and garden favors.

changed_reading.before: Rabb is an abstract possessor who gives already finished objects.
changed_reading.after: Rabb is also encountered through coordinated water, flow, and growth: the favors are cultivated processes whose completion the Lord continuously administers.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near fruit is gathered, then good action is answered by good. This sequence activates the focus's oath, pact, and fulfilled-charge branches as reciprocity: received cultivation calls for an answering enactment, not gratitude as sentiment alone.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch supplies a pledged dimension to receiving and answering favor.
The covenant branch makes reciprocity a binding relation under the Lord.
A charge validated by being carried through turns acknowledgment into enacted fidelity.
Taking ripe yield from its growing place materializes what the recipient receives.
Matching an act with its recompense establishes the return arrow.
Good action, repeated on both sides of the equation, defines the quality of reciprocal performance.

structural_cues: The garden descriptions move from available yield at 55:54 to the reciprocity formula at 55:60 and another refrain at 55:61.
The focus's dual addressees remain responsible recipients even when the immediate garden grammar describes reward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harvested yield, matched recompense, and good action; I infer that acknowledgment should return received good through conduct. A live alternative confines 55:60 to divine recompense and assigns no reciprocal duty to the recipients.

changed_reading.before: Acknowledgment is an inward or verbal response to divine generosity.
changed_reading.after: The favor-pact asks for enacted return: which gifts do you two falsify by receiving their yield without carrying good forward as good?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This crosses a plant-name branch of ء ل و with the deceptive-cloth branch of ك ذ ب, so it must not be presented as the lexical translation of the ayah. It remains anchored in both focus roots and is activated by red, oily, branching, and patterned surfaces in the context; downstream prose should call it an imagistic warning about attractive surfaces carrying a bitter or unstable underside.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus ءَالَاءِ can activate the beautiful-but-bitter ala shrub, while focus تُكَذِّبَانِ can activate appearance that deceives by its variegation.

activation_trace.role: The ala shrub, pleasing in appearance but bitter in taste, supplies the outlier's split between surface and experience.
Variegated cloth whose appearance deceives turns denial into misreading a surface.
Flower and red-infused color supply an attractive but catastrophic visual surface.
Oil or coating adds a transformed, slick appearance to the same warning scene.
Mixed coloration without stability keeps visual variety from functioning as simple proof of permanence.
Fine patterned carpets provide the positive counterpart to deceptive variegation.

changed_reading.after: Which displays of your Lord do you falsify by reading only their attractive surface and refusing the bitter, unstable, or warning-bearing underside?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The last-breath branch comes through the packet's non-dominant split mapping and is too distant to gloss ءَالَاء directly. Its validity is structural and imagistic: the focus immediately follows universal extinction and precedes renewed daily action. Render it only as a threshold echo that intensifies urgency, not as an alternative dictionary meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split-mapped focus root carries a last-breath branch, while focus ك ذ ب carries a branch of not delaying action.

activation_trace.role: The last gasp makes the focus refrain audible at the threshold where created persistence ends.
Not delaying before action supplies urgency to acknowledgment at that threshold.
Passing away after a period of persistence supplies the immediate extinction frame.
Remaining duration sets the enduring counterpoint against which the final-breath image sounds.

changed_reading.before: The repeated question can be deferred as one more rhetorical prompt.
changed_reading.after: At 55:28 the refrain can sound like a last-breath summons: before created continuity cuts off, which sustaining realities will you still delay acknowledging?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mariners' chief is a rare branch of ر ب ب and must not replace 'Lord' in translation. It remains worth carrying because the focus root is exact and the surah explicitly supplies raised ships running on broad water; downstream prose should present it as a navigation analogy for commanded passage and administered provision.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus رَبِّ activates a mariners' chief branch within a question about the Lord's favors.

activation_trace.role: A mariners' chief gives lordship the concrete function of directing passage.
Bestowed favors identify safe and enabled passage as provision rather than autonomous mastery.
Running and coursing supply the vessel's movement under direction.
Rising and elevation supply the raised ship image that makes the nautical role visible.
Broad abundant water provides the field across which administered passage occurs.
Passing cleanly to the other side generalizes the navigation image into authorized crossing.

changed_reading.before: Movement through sea or cosmos displays the travelers' capacity.
changed_reading.after: Which provisions of the directing Lord do you deny when vessel, passage, and the possibility of crossing remain under an authority like a chief at sea?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The animal that runs and then stops to look back is a remote branch image of ك ذ ب, not the verb's contextual gloss. It remains anchored in focus denial and gains a visible mechanism from attempted penetration followed by inability to secure aid. Qualify it as a movement analogy for denial exposed by its own failed escape.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus تُكَذِّبَانِ carries a branch image of a running creature that halts and looks behind.

activation_trace.role: Running a stage, stopping, and looking back supplies denial's failed-flight trajectory.
Clean passage to the far side defines the escape that the addressees are challenged to attempt.
Aid and vindicating support, explicitly unavailable in the scene, mark the point where flight stalls.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a static proposition held by the addressees.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be pictured as flight that initially runs but cannot cross the boundary, stops without aid, and is forced to look back at the evidence it fled.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence turns favors from detachable benefits into a calibrated nurture system spanning knowledge, measure, justice, and growth.
The exact placement of 55:28 between extinction, remaining, and daily need makes it a hinge about transient yields and renewed care.
Calculation, balance, recurrence, and recompense strengthen a coexisting reading of each refrain as an outstanding claim carried forward.
Warning scenes revise favor to include truth-preserving limits and exposure, while water and garden scenes materialize lordship as coordinated cultivation.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mappings kept juridical, sequential, antiphonal, ecological, and imagistic activations alive beside the ordinary favor reading. The focus occurrence was not flattened into the other refrains: its mortality-to-daily-action hinge generated a distinct abductive change.
remaining_uncertainties: The ت ل و branches are packet-authorized but non-dominant, so the trailing-right, responding-voice, and last-breath readings remain exploratory rather than lexical replacements.
The warning sequence can either include corrective boundary within favor or contrast punishment with favor; both directional readings remain live.
The covenantal return may describe reciprocal human performance, or 55:60 may restrict the return arrow to divine recompense.
Material outliers such as bitter shrub, deceptive cloth, mariners' chief, and stalled flight should remain qualified images rather than direct translations.
